svg.title: Kite II
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Eleven joined panels: four pairs of colored-over-black squares and three white vertical rectangles. White separators retained; no open gaps.
